belief_records.strategy: Cooperate with unknown players when the expected benefit to good players exceeds the risk; use observed actions to guide later choices.
Start with C, which favors collective payoff when facing a good player. Update beliefs from observed actions and cooperate with likely good players; defect against likely selfish players.
Cooperate with an untested player to support mutual cooperation among good players; update beliefs and respond to observed actions in later rounds.
Cooperate with likely good players to raise their collective payoff; update from observed actions and defect when evidence indicates an opponent is selfish.

Start with C, since cooperation with a good player benefits the good-player total. Use encounter actions to update beliefs and cooperate with likely good players; defect against likely selfish players.
